gb.title: ‘It’s not about sex but empowerment’: why I picked a ‘naked’ frock as dress of the year
gb.description: Sarah Burton’s sporty, daffodil mesh dress made me smile. But the reason I chose it for Fashion Museum Bath is because it tells the story of our times, when bodies are more political than ever One morning in February this year, I opened my laptop to find an email with an all-caps subject line: TOP SECRET. Being a fashion editor can be exciting but state secrets are not generally my beat, so I was intrigued. Sure enough, it was a thrill: an invitation from the Fashion Museum Bath to choose their Dress of the Year for 2025. What an honour. Dress of the Year began in 1963, the brainchild of the museum’s founder Doris Langley Moore, as a way of keeping a static collection perpetually current. Each year a fashion expert picks an outfit or outfits that capture the year just gone, and these become part of the permanent collection. There is a Mary Quant dress and a Katharine Hamnett slogan T-shirt, Ossie Clark chiffon and Ralph Lauren pinstripes. There is sublime beauty from the catwalks of Yves Saint Laurent and Chanel and John Galliano, and pieces of cultural history: McQueen’s bumsters, Jennifer Lopez’s internet-breaking green Versace Grammy dress, Dior’s “We Should All Be Feminists” slogan, Naomi Campbell’s pandemic hazmat suit, a Black Lives Matter T-shirt, and the dress worn by the Duchess of Sussex for her Oprah interview in 2021. “Dress” is interpreted loosely, in the sense of clothing rather than a frock: the lineup includes men’s suits. The Bath museum is currently mid-revamp, having closed its doors in 2022, with construction soon to start on a new museum set to open in the city’s old post office in 2030. Meanwhile the collection is stored in Wiltshire and can be seen online. Continue reading...

de.title: SV Schlierbach: Michael Lukas glänzt bei Landes- und Deutschen Meisterschaften
de.description: Mit herausragenden Leistungen auf Landesebene und starken Platzierungen bei den nationalen Titelkämpfen in Hannover stellte der Sportschütze seine Treffsicherheit in den Auflagedisziplinen eindrucksvoll unter Beweis. Bereits im Frühsommer legte Lukas das Fundament für ein erfolgreiches Sportjahr. Am 31. Mai 2026 sicherte er sich bei der Landesmeisterschaft in der Disziplin Sportpistole Auflage mit einer konzentrierten Leistung den hervorragenden 3. Platz. Nur wenige Wochen später, am 21. Juni 2026, knüpfte er nahtlos an diesen Erfolg an: Auch bei der Landesmeisterschaft Freie Pistole Auflage schoss er sich zielsicher auf das Podest und holte erneut die Bronzemedaille. Dank dieser Spitzenplatzierungen qualifizierte sich der Schlierbacher für die Deutschen Meisterschaften in Hannover. Im harten Wettkampf mit Deutschlands besten Auflageschützen behauptete sich Lukas im Mittelfeld der nationalen Elite. In der Disziplin Sportpistole Auflage erreichte er einen starken 23. Platz unter 46 Startern. Noch größer war das Teilnehmerfeld bei der Freien Pistole Auflage: Hier setzte er sich gegen die breite Konkurrenz durch und belegte einen beachtlichen 34. Platz von insgesamt 104 Schützen. Michael Lukas zeigte sich im Rückblick überaus glücklich mit den Ergebnissen: „Ich freue mich riesig über die Erfolge in diesem Jahr und die Medaillen bei den Landesmeisterschaften“, bilanziert der Schütze zufrieden. Doch wer den Schützen kennt, weiß, dass nach dem Wettkampf vor dem Wettkampf ist. Trotz aller Freude bleibt sein sportlicher Ehrgeiz ungebrochen: „Das Niveau auf Bundesebene ist enorm hoch, aber das motiviert mich nur noch mehr. Ich will im Training weiter hart an mir arbeiten, um in Zukunft noch mehr zu erreichen und meine Platzierungen weiter zu verbessern.“ Mit diesem Mix aus Freude, Stolz und gesundem Ehrgeiz blickt nicht nur Michael Lukas, sondern der gesamte Schützenverein Schlierbach 1924 e.V. optimistisch auf die kommenden sportlichen Herausforderungen.

es.title: El Barça lleva sus equipaciones a otro nivel
es.description: El FC Barcelona ha decidido ir un paso más allá con sus camisetas esta temporada. Cada una de las tres equipaciones del Barça de la campaña 26/27 cuenta con una tipografía propia para los nombres y los dorsales, haciendo que cada camiseta tenga una identidad diferente. La primera equipación, la blaugrana, apuesta por un diseño inspirado en el modernismo catalán. La segunda mira directamente al mundo del baloncesto y tiene a Kobe Bryant como una de sus principales referencias. La tercera, en cambio, viaja hasta los años 90 para recuperar el estilo de los dorsales que Nike utilizaba en aquella época. El resultado es que los jugadores del Barça pueden lucir tres estilos de dorsales diferentes dependiendo de la camiseta que vistan, algo poco habitual en el fútbol. El modernismo llega a la primera camiseta La tipografía de la primera equipación toma como inspiración el modernismo catalán, con formas estilizadas, proporciones verticales y remates orgánicos que buscan trasladar parte de ese lenguaje visual a los nombres y números. Esta tipografía será utilizada por el primer equipo masculino en la Champions League, la Copa del Rey y la Supercopa, mientras que en LaLiga el Barça seguirá utilizando la tipografía establecida por la competición. Kobe Bryant inspira la segunda equipación La segunda camiseta tiene una referencia especialmente llamativa. Su tipografía está inspirada en Kobe Bryant y en la estética del baloncesto, trasladando elementos asociados a la conocida 'Mamba Mentality'. Los nombres y dorsales presentan una tipografía serif de alto contraste, con formas alargadas y números muy verticales. El dorado refuerza además la estética de la camiseta y contrasta con su fondo oscuro. La tercera camiseta viaja a los años 90 La tercera equipación recupera el estilo de los dorsales clásicos de los años 90, una época especialmente reconocible para los aficionados al fútbol. Los números presentan formas más contundentes, compactas y geométricas, recordando a los diseños utilizados por Nike durante aquella década, aunque adaptados a una interpretación actual. De esta manera, las tres camisetas representan tres referencias diferentes: Barcelona y el modernismo en la primera, Kobe Bryant y el baloncesto en la segunda y los años 90 en la tercera.

es.title: Grupo Conquero suma la marca internacional GWM a su oferta de automoción en Huelva
es.description: Grupo Conquero ha ampliado su oferta de automoción en Huelva con la incorporación del fabricante internacional GWM, una firma que presta servicio a más de 16 millones de usuarios en todo el mundo. La marca ha comenzado a operar en la capital onubense a través de HEBEI AUTO, concesionario ubicado en la avenida de las Veredas, 50, en el Polígono La Paz de Huelva. La propuesta de GWM destaca por su apuesta por la investigación, el desarrollo tecnológico y una movilidad adaptada a distintas necesidades. Sus automóviles combinan diseño, conectividad y asistentes de conducción, con opciones de propulsión de gasolina, híbridas y eléctricas. El modelo ORA 5 encabeza este desembarco con una oferta de motorizaciones orientada a responder a los diferentes hábitos de conducción. Antes de finalizar 2026, la gama se amplía con la llegada del SUV GWM H7, la propuesta urbana y familiar JOLION MAX, y el todoterreno 4x4 Tank 300, disponible en el último mes de ese año. Para el año 2027, la marca prevé incorporar un Pick Up y un Monovolumen premium. Todos los automóviles disponen de una garantía comercial de siete años o 150.000 kilómetros, ofreciendo a los conductores alternativas respaldadas por la experiencia de Grupo Conquero.

Il 65% delle PMI crede che in Italia ancora oggi i lavori pagati meglio li trova chi è raccomandato. Per decenni c'era il colloquio vis a vis poi, complice la pandemia, è esploso quello a distanza, ora si fa sempre più strada quello gestito da algoritmi e chatbot. Infatti, se da una parte sempre più aziende utilizzano algoritmi per filtrare parole chiave e strumenti basati sull'IA per fare le interviste, i giovani candidati, specie quelli della generazione Z, a loro volta si rivolgono a queste nuove opportunità tecnologiche non solo per scrivere i CV (lo fa il 58% di loro) ma anche per superare le selezioni algoritmiche delle aziende. Per perfezionare i curricula e superare certi filtri imposti di nuovi algoritmi, 1 candidato su 5 utilizza chatbot e l'IA per individuare il proprio lavoro ideale ma anche per simulare colloqui veri e propri, al fine di impostare le risposte più appropriate. È quanto emerge dalla ricerca dell’”Osservatorio Evolution Forum Business School sulle PMI", ideato dal formatore Gianluca Spadoni su un panel di oltre 1200 micro e piccole imprese (cioè con fatturato sino a 1 milione di euro, e meno di 5 dipendenti). Sull’ipotesi di selezionare il personale in questo modo, le PMI sono prudenti: secondo l'"Osservatorio Evolution Forum Business School sulle PMI" il 42% infatti potrebbe utilizzare l’AI per alcuni tipi di selezioni; mentre il 29% non sa. Il 19% pensa di potersi fidare dell’AI ma solo per la selezione del personale. C’è però un problema sugli investimenti per implementare l’AI a tutti i livelli delle PMI italiane. Il 43% delle PMI crede che l’AI costi ancora troppo per le loro dimensioni. Mentre il 31% sta valutando di riallocare sull’AI investimenti pensati inizialmente per altre attività. Il 9% delle PMI si dice però pronta a tutto pur di trovare i fondi per implementare l’AI nella propria azienda. Infine uno schiacciante 57% delle PMI pensa che ad affidarsi all’AI in maniera massiccia siano soprattutto le medio/grandi aziende, cioè con fatturato oltre i 100 milioni di euro. Sono loro infatti le sole a potersi permettere investimenti importanti nell’AI a tutti i livelli aziendali. In USA questo fenomeno è decisamente più marcato. Infatti un recente articolo di CBS dal titolo “AI interviews rolling out for some federal government hires, sources say”, svela come persino il governo federale degli Stati Uniti stia iniziando a testare agenti virtuali IA per i primi colloqui di selezione del personale tecnico. Fino ad arrivare al reportage “Job Seekers Are Using AI During Interviews” di Newsweek che rivela che molti candidati usino di nascosto l'IA in tempo reale per farsi suggerire le risposte durante i colloqui con i recruiter. Ma la ricerca dell’”Osservatorio Evolution Forum Business School sulle PMI" rivela che anche in Italia questo fenomeno sta prendendo piede, a partire dalle PMI, che usano sempre più l’AI nelle preselezioni dei loro candidati (per il 19%). E più aumenta il fatturato della PMI e più è marcata questa tendenza a ricorrere all’AI. Gianluca Spadoni direttore dell’”Osservatorio Evolution Forum Business School sulle PMI” e che nel corso della sua carriera ha formato oltre 550mila persone, commenta: «Il fatto che i giovani si rivolgano alle aziende attraverso le tecnologie non è una novità. Oggi lo fanno attraverso l'IA, ieri lo facevano attraverso i social o altri canali digitali. Ovvio che il modo di cercare il proprio spazio nel mondo è diverso se si tratta di generazioni Z o di persone più mature. Le persone più mature mandano ancora i curricula. I giovani hanno proprio invertito il processo e le aziende devono capire che non sono più loro a selezionare, ma sono i giovani a scegliere le aziende. Le aziende - continua Spadoni - devono imparare a vendersi, a raccontarsi, a costruire percorsi di crescita. Anche un'azienda piccola deve avere una grande visione. Bisogna smettere di pensare al fatto che non si trovano lavoratori. Ci si deve cosa si fa per trovarli veramente» Inoltre, secondo l'"Osservatorio Evolution Forum Business School sulle PMI", il 66% di chi si rivolge a selezioni digitali lo fa perché punta ad andarsene all'estero a lavorare: «È uno dei temi che abbiamo: dobbiamo tornare a essere più affascinanti, più competitivi, più attrattivi. Dobbiamo essere - continua Gianluca Spadoni - più vicini ai bisogni dei ragazzi intervenendo anche con politiche fiscali che permettano di mettere più soldi nelle tasche perché molti vanno via non perché non siamo affascinanti ma perché paghiamo poco. E paghiamo poco perché il cuneo fiscale ci ammazza: non è pensabile che un ragazzo di 25 / 30 anni che ha voglia di fare non possa attraverso il suo lavoro costruirsi una casa o sostenere un mutuo, è immorale, ci stiamo giocando il futuro». Stando sempre all'Osservatorio, il 65% delle PMI crede che in Italia ancora oggi i lavori pagati meglio li trova chi è raccomandato: «Penso che il digitale abbia permesso alle persone di avere maggiore possibilità di imparare che la conoscenza è il modo con cui la democrazia esercita la propria possibilità di scalata sociale e che, mai come adesso, le persone possono imparare se vogliono. Magari - conclude Spadoni - ci sono delle opportunità di crescita professionale che si aprono grazie a buone relazioni, ma poi in quelle posizioni ci rimani solo se sei veramente bravo».

in.title: Hello, I want to buy a Kia Seltos. My daily running is around 40 km in the city, with occasional 200-400 km highway trips a month. I’m confused between the HTX A Petrol IVT and HTX A Diesel Manual. I’m not a fan of automatic variants, but I’m considering the automatic because the HTX A petrol manual comes with 16-inch steel wheels. Please suggest which variant I should go for.
in.description: Go for the Seltos HTX(A) diesel manual. With about 40km of city driving a day plus a few highway runs, you'll cover roughly 17,000- 19,000 km a year. At that mileage, the diesel's better fuel efficiency adds up to a real saving, enough to recover its price premium over the petrol IVT within a few years. It also lets you keep the manual gearbox you prefer. Be aware that the diesel is relaxed rather than punchy, and its clutch is heavier than the petrol's, so daily city traffic will take a bit more effort. Your regular highway trips will also help keep the diesel particulate filter healthy. If you'd rather not spend extra on the diesel, there's another option. Buy the HTX(A) petrol manual and fit good aftermarket alloys for a fraction of the price difference. You keep the manual and save around Rs 2 lakh upfront, but at your mileage, the diesel will win on running costs over the long term.

ph.title: Phivolcs records minor phreatomagmatic eruption at Taal Volcano
ph.description: A five-minute minor phreatomagmatic eruption occurred at the Main Crater of Taal Volcano on Thursday evening, Oct. 8, producing a dark gray plume that rose 4,000 meters above the crater. The eruption began at 6:06 p.m. and was confirmed through seismic and camera recordings from the Taal Volcano Network, the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) said. The plume was recorded by the Main Crater West Rim (VTWR), Daang Kastila (VTDK), and Buco (VTBC) cameras. Phivolcs warned that thin ashfall may affect the southwestern lakeshore towns of Agoncillo, Lemery, San Nicolas, Taal, and Batangas, as well as adjacent areas. A phreatomagmatic eruption occurs when magma interacts with water, generating steam, ash, and occasionally fragmented volcanic materials. Prior to the eruption, Phivolcs recorded 82 minutes of volcanic tremor during its 24-hour monitoring period from midnight of Oct. 7 to midnight of Oct. 8. Alert Level 1, which indicates low-level unrest, remains in effect over Taal Volcano. The public is advised against entering the Taal Volcano Island, particularly near the Main Crater and the Daang Kastila fissure, which are permanent danger zones. Occupancy and boating on Taal Lake are also prohibited, while aircraft are advised against flying close to the volcano. Phivolcs reminded the public that possible hazards include steam-driven or phreatic or gas-driven explosions, volcanic earthquakes, minor ashfall, and lethal accumulations or expulsions of volcanic gas.

ph.title: MINISFORUM Launches MS-S1 MAX-P495 with 192GB Unified Memory, Expanding Its Local AI Computing Strategy
ph.description: SHENZHEN, China, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As Artificial Intelligence (AI) evolves toward Super Intelligence (SI), intelligent computing is entering a new phase—one in which increasingly capable AI is moving closer to endpoints and edge environments. This shift is accelerating demand for local large-model processing, data privacy, low-latency performance, and greater control over AI workloads. In response, MINISFORUM is advancing its Local AI strategy from high-performance AI systems toward scalable local computing platforms. The new MS-S1 MAX-P495 is the latest step in this evolution, bringing powerful local AI computing to the edge and helping bridge today's AI era with the emerging era of Super Intelligence. MINISFORUM MS-S1 MAX-P495 From 395 to P495: More Headroom for Local AI Following the MS-S1 MAX powered by the AMD Ryzen™ AI Max+ 395, MINISFORUM is introducing the MS-S1 MAX-P495, powered by the AMD Ryzen™ AI Max+ PRO 495. Built on the Zen 5 architecture, the processor features 16 cores and 32 threads, with clock speeds of up to 5.2GHz, and integrates Radeon™ 8065S Graphics. It delivers up to 55 TOPS of NPU performance and 131 TOPS of total AI compute, targeting AI enthusiasts, developers, geeks, and professional creators with higher demands for local high-performance computing. 192GB Unified Memory Keeps Larger Models Local Compared with the MS-S1 MAX powered by the Ryzen™ AI Max+ 395, the P495's key upgrades are focused on memory and VRAM capacity. Maximum unified memory increases from 128GB to 192GB, while maximum allocatable VRAM rises from 96GB to 160GB. The larger shared CPU-GPU memory pool further increases the scale of models that can be handled by a single system, providing more room for demanding local AI workloads. The MS-S1 MAX-P495 supports running 300B-class large language models locally. In model testing, DeepSeek V4 Flash 284B (Q4) ran on a single system at approximately 12 tok/s. This enables local inference, AI application development, multimodal generation, as well as professional creative workloads such as AI-assisted creation and 3D rendering. The significance of this generation goes beyond higher specifications. It further expands the scale of local AI workloads that can be handled by a compact workstation. From a Single Desktop System to Dual-System Clusters and 2U Rack Deployment The local AI computing capabilities of the MS-S1 MAX-P495 can be further expanded through multi-system deployment. Two 192GB MS-S1 MAX-P495 units can form a dual-system cluster capable of running Qwen3.5-397B locally at approximately 16 tok/s. The system also supports 2U rack deployment, allowing multiple units to be linked together to form a distributed cluster. In testing, a four-system configuration successfully ran DeepSeek-R1 671B Q4 (380GB, Q4_0 quantization). From a single system to dual-system clusters and multi-node deployments, the MS-S1 MAX-P495 extends local AI computing from individual desktop environments to larger-scale deployments for enterprises and research teams. For MINISFORUM, Local AI is not simply about improving the performance of individual products; it represents an important direction for the company's future computing portfolio. Around the needs of locally deployed large models, professional AI workloads, and scalable computing, MINISFORUM is continuing to develop a product portfolio spanning high-performance standalone workstations and multi-node deployments, enabling more AI computing to be completed locally. The MS-S1 MAX-P495 is not merely another product iteration, but another step in MINISFORUM's continued expansion from high-performance standalone Local AI systems toward scalable local computing platforms. The MS-S1 MAX-P495 with 192GB RAM and a 2TB SSD is now available for pre-order at a regular price of US$9,249, with a 20% discount bringing the price to US$7,399. bd.title: Dongpeng Highlights Sustainable Procurement at UN Global Compact Leaders Summit
bd.description: Supplier capability building and circular materials connect sustainability requirements with opportunities for collaboration FOSHAN, China, Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Guangdong Dongpeng Holdings Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 003012), a Chinese building materials company, presented an approach linking supplier capability building with circular material innovation at the 2026 United Nations Global Compact Leaders Summit in New York. The company shared how manufacturers and buyers can help suppliers put sustainability requirements into practice and collaborate to turn industrial residues into building materials. On Sept. 23, Ying He, vice chair and president of Dongpeng, joined representatives from Schneider Electric, Sacyr and other organizations for the SPARK session "Transforming Supply Chain Pressure Into Growth and Opportunity." She drew on Dongpeng's experience as both a manufacturer and a buyer to discuss how procurement can support supplier improvement, innovation and resilience. Ms. Ying He, Vice Chair and President of DONGPENG (second from left), addresses global business leaders during the SPARK session “Transforming Supply Chain Pressure Into Growth and Opportunity” at the 2026 UN Global Compact Leaders Summit in New York. Held during the high-level week of the United Nations General Assembly, the summit emphasized measurable business action and collaboration across value chains. Procurement was a key focus, with discussions examining how purchasing decisions and supplier relationships can strengthen resilience and competitiveness as companies navigate regulatory change and fragmented trade. Helping suppliers put sustainability into practice She outlined a "3E" approach: Educate, Engage and Empower. Educate translates sustainability targets into clear requirements. Engage brings procurement, research and development, manufacturing, suppliers and customers into two-way collaboration. Empower combines tools, training and commercial incentives to help partners improve. The approach maintains common expectations while recognizing that suppliers need implementation pathways suited to their capabilities and circumstances. "Sustainability should become a capability that companies build together with their partners, translated into everyday actions that can be measured, verified and continuously improved," said Ying He. Dongpeng has integrated environmental, social and governance considerations into supplier onboarding, evaluation and procurement decisions, and has provided dedicated training to more than 20 core suppliers. This work connects purchasing requirements with practical support for the companies expected to meet them. Turning industrial residues into building materials Dongpeng also shared its work with supply chain partners to develop non-fired eco-stone using discarded ceramics and mineral residues. By combining suppliers' material knowledge with its manufacturing and design capabilities, the company is exploring applications in panels and urban furniture. The work connects resource recovery with product development and potential demand from construction and urban projects. Alongside efforts to reduce energy use, emissions and waste in conventional ceramic production, Dongpeng is exploring further collaboration with cities, architects and industry partners to apply these materials in public spaces and urban renewal. Contributing to the sustainable procurement dialogue Dongpeng also attended the High-Level Forum on Sustainable Procurement at United Nations Headquarters on Sept. 21. At the forum, the UN Global Compact launched its Sustainable Procurement Implementation Framework to help organizations embed sustainability in procurement decisions, processes and supplier relationships. For Dongpeng, the exchanges connected its manufacturing experience in China with the challenges facing buyers and suppliers in other markets. The company is seeking collaboration with international partners on supplier capability building and circular material applications, with approaches adapted to local resources, production conditions and market needs. bd.title: 2026 World Fire Congress Communities of Practice Unite Global Fire Service Leaders Around Shared Solutions for The Future of Fire Safety
bd.description: Powered by UL Research Institutes, the Communities of Practice offer a sustained mechanism to share knowledge, align on emerging risks, and rapidly translate research across borders COLUMBIA, Md., Oct. 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Following the biennial gathering of the world's fire leaders at the World Fire Congress, UL Research Institutes' Fire Safety Research Institute is powering the ongoing Communities of Practice (CoPs) to advance solutions for the most pressing global fire safety issues. The structured and sustained CoPs will accelerate progress through monthly thematic sessions, shared governance, robust information distribution and direct integration of frontline research. "The inaugural World Fire Congress and Communities of Practice in 2024 established the foundation for sustained and collaborative knowledge exchange, and ULRI is honored to build on that foundation," said Dr. Lori Moore-Merrell, World Fire Congress founder and chief fire safety strategist for the Fire Safety Research Institute. "Drawing on more than a century of fire research and leadership, ULRI is bringing its scientific rigor into the global conversation, ensuring the dialogue is grounded in evidence over anecdote." The World Fire Congress CoPs offer the fire service a mechanism to share knowledge, align on emerging risks and translate research and training into practice across borders. Through ULRI, members gain access to a trusted international network, curated best practices and direct engagement with leading researchers and their work on areas including lithium-ion battery safety, EV fire risk, climate adaptation and evidence-based tactical decision-making. Each CoP will be equipped with the necessary infrastructure to collaborate across nations and will be grounded with an Anchor Organization to bring established expertise and leadership to each Community. The 2026 - 2028 CoPs, along with their Anchor Organizations, include: Climate Driven Large Scale Events: As fire, storm and flood events exceed planned assumptions, resource capacities and tactical doctrine of even the most well-resourced emergency response services, the challenge is no longer suppression, but systemic resilience across every hazard. This Community will focus on cross-border, all-hazard mutual-aid structures; compound cascading risk from wildfire, storm and flood; and pre-positioning, early warning and evacuation strategies that work across contexts. Anchor Organizations: Global Fire Management Hub at United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization and California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CalFire) Emerging Technology and Artificial Intelligence: Emerging technologies, including AI-powered detection, satellite monitoring, and autonomous apparatus or smart PPE, can synthesize vast data streams and give commanders unprecedented situational awareness when seconds matter, but caution is also needed as these powerful tools still require governance and human oversight. This Community will focus on identifying what's working; governance and human-oversight frameworks for responsible adoption; closing the equity gap; and sharing evidence-based research results. Anchor Organization: Dubai Civil Defence Data: The Foundation of Evidence Driven Fire Services: Fire service decisions are only as strong as the data behind them. Yet, fire data remains fragmented, inconsistent and rarely shared across jurisdictions or borders, with acute gaps in lower-resource settings. This Community will focus on data governance and interoperability; minimum viable data schema and standards for low-resource settings; and a global fire-intelligence ecosystem that serves every nation. Anchor Organizations: UL Research Institutes' Fire Safety Research Institute and Earth Fire Alliance Fire in Low- and Middle-Income Nations (LMICs): Fire is one of the world's most inequitable killers with 95% of deaths from fire and burn-related injuries happening in low- and middle-income countries. Dense informal settlements, combustible construction, open-flame cooking and under-resourced rescue services compound the toll. This Community will focus on capacity building and technology transfer; community-based fire risk reduction in informal settlements; and genuine partnership that centers LMIC voices and leadership. Anchor Organizations: Kindling Safety, Africa Fire Mission, and the World Bank Firefighting: Tactics and Training: The fire service is facing mounting complexity in the wildland-urban interface (WUI) and from lithium-ion batteries, high-rise and informal-structure fires, industrial and chemical hazards, and large-scale disaster co-response. Firefighter training and response tactics that are standardized in one nation may be unknown to another, and many tactics may be transferable across borders or may need adaptation for the unique needs of a nation. The focus of this Community will be to compare doctrine and share incident lessons; close the training gap on lithium-ion batteries, WUI and industrial hazards; and advance simulation and technology enhanced training toward shared standards. Anchor Organization: UL Research Institutes' Fire Safety Research Institute Firefighter Health and Safety: Firefighters face some of the most serious occupational risks of any profession with occupational cancer being one of the leading causes of line-of-duty death. Globally, the nature of risks and the protections against them remain deeply uneven. This Community will focus on building shared knowledge of the cardiovascular, mental health, cancer and toxic exposure risks; advocate for a universal standard of firefighter health and safety; and share evidence-based results. Anchor Organizations: Science Alliance and the International Association of Fire Fighters (IAFF) Women in the Fire Service: Women remain dramatically underrepresented in fire and civil defense services worldwide. But the barriers are not about capacity as women perform 57% of all volunteer work. The focus of this Community will be on recruitment, retention and leadership pathways; PPE solutions that work for women firefighters; and culture change and policy. Anchor Organizations: Women in Fire and Women and Firefighting Australasia (WAFA) Fire and Civil Defense in Conflict and Hostile Environments: Fire and rescue personnel in many nations now operate in an environment marked by deliberate attacks, hybrid threats, and prolonged instability. These conditions demand new approaches to responder protection, service continuity, and legal safeguards that extend beyond conventional fire doctrine. This Community will connect agencies working in conflict-affected or hostile environments, strengthen understanding of civil defense protections under international humanitarian law, and support practical strategies for readiness, recovery, and resilience. Anchor Organization: International Association of Fire and Rescue Services (CTIF) In addition to Moore-Merrell, CoPs leadership includes Mark Hardingham, CoPs Ambassador. With a career spanning four decades from UK firefighter to Chief Fire Officer to former chair of the UK National Fire Chiefs Council. Diane Haithcock serves as CoPs Administrator. Haithcock is Director, Program Manager for UL Standards & Engagement (ULSE) where she oversees ULSE Technical Committee chairs and project managers across the U.S. and Canada for standards related to life safety products, physical security, building materials, and wildland-urban interface. In collaboration with ULRI's Fire Safety Research Institute, ULSE supports monthly meetings, research analysis, and reports for CoPs members. The World Fire Congress is a biennial global forum bringing together fire and emergency service leaders, government representatives, researchers and partners to strengthen international cooperation, share knowledge and support evidence-informed discussion on fire and life safety challenges facing communities worldwide. The inaugural World Fire Congress was held in Washington D.C. in 2024. The National Fire Chiefs Council hosted the second World Fire Congress in London, September 8-9, 2026, with representatives from more than 60 nations attending. The World Fire Congress is led by an international steering committee, including the host nation, and supported by the Metropolitan Fire Chiefs Association (Metro Chiefs) as its Secretariat. Metro Chiefs is a section of the National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) and the International Association of Fire Chiefs (IAFC). The Secretariat provides continuity between Congresses, supports host nations and helps sustain international collaboration between events. The next World Fire Congress will be hosted by Dubai Civil Defence in the United Arab Emirates in February 2028. For more information visit WFCCOP.fsri.org. About Fire Safety Research Institute UL Research Institutes' Fire Safety Research Institute advances fire science and fire safety knowledge to reduce risk, save lives, and protect property. We conduct rigorous research, outreach, and education in collaboration with the fire service, fire safety professionals, policymakers, communities, and an international network of partners. Together, we develop tools, resources, and strategies that improve fire safety outcomes worldwide. To learn more, visit fsri.org. Follow Fire Safety Research Institute on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn. About UL Standards & Engagement UL Standards & Engagement is a nonprofit organization that translates safety science into action through standards development, partnerships, and advocacy. Since 1903, we have developed nearly 1,700 standards and guidance documents for products ranging from fire doors to autonomous vehicles. ULSE enables innovation and grows trust by convening experts and informing policymakers and regulators as we work toward a safer, more secure and sustainable future. Visit ULSE.org for more information. About UL Research Institutes UL Research Institutes is a nonprofit research organization dedicated to advancing public safety through scientific discovery. Since 1894, our research has advanced our mission toward a safer, more secure and sustainable future. Focused on global risks from fire mitigation and air quality to safe energy storage and digital privacy, we conduct rigorous independent research, analyze safety data and partner with experts to uncover and act on existing and emerging risks to human safety. Discover more at UL.org. About the World Fire Congress The World Fire Congress is a biennial global forum focused on strengthening international cooperation, knowledge sharing, and evidence-informed dialogue on fire and life safety challenges facing communities worldwide. Guided by its founding principles, the Congress brings together fire and emergency service leaders, researchers, and partners to advance collaboration on firefighter health and safety, wildfires, structural fires, emerging technologies, prevention, response, recovery, and resilience.

pk.title: Are AI Chatbots Hesitant to Recommend Change? Study Finds Climate-Related Status Quo Bias
pk.description: A new study of multiple large language models (LLMs) found that when users asked chatbots for advice, they were more likely to make suggestions that favour the status quo over alternatives. The tendency of artificial intelligence to default to more common advice could be bad news for the climate. Researchers from the University of Waterloo assessed 11 LLMs for their tendency to prefer existing conditions over change, known as status quo bias. Well-known in psychology research, this is the first paper to apply the concept to climate advice from LLMs. The team evaluated more than 7,500 queries spanning multiple domains, including vehicle purchases, recipes, home heating, and climate-relevant policy trade-offs. Each of these queries was tested on at least six different LLMs for a total of nearly 55,000 prompts. Where climate trade-offs are possible in policy, platforms reinforced decisions the user already made with double the frequency. LLMs commonly provide advice that runs counter to changes needed from households and decision makers for climate action. Given the proliferation of AI, progress on climate change is at risk if the status quo favours high emissions. “I think it's worth being aware that these models, even the new ones, have blind spots,” said Dr. Seth Wynes, professor in the Faculty of Environment. “It's good for consumers to be aware of this bias and if you're asking for advice on a topic, you could ask it to make the case for doing something new.” While different models responded similarly during the study, the findings were most obvious in policymaking. When models were asked whether to proceed with a plan, they said "yes" 70 per cent of the time for plans that were already in place but only agreed 34 per cent of the time when the plan or policy was new. While researchers noted that models do take regional patterns into consideration, they still showed a surprising bias here as well. For instance, if you claim to be a user from Norway, where sales of new electric vehicles are very high, the chatbot is more likely to recommend an EV than if you are from Canada. But in both cases, the bot will recommend an EV less often than the pace at which EVs are already being sold in their respective country. “In almost every jurisdiction, the LLMs are working at at slower pace of change than is needed, so they recommend fewer EV models than what are actually being sold today,” Wynes said. “It might be very good for AI to favour the status quo for lots of other things, such as proven medical advice, but climate is where we really do need change.” In the future, the researchers will keep tabs on advances in LLMs and if and whether humans are relying on AI to make purchases within the AI platform, amplifying the effect of any status quo bias. The study, Large language models exhibit status quo bias in climate-relevant advice, appears in Environmental Research Communications. Fact-Checked by Irfan Ahmad. ae.title: India establishes 5.56 km open-air quantum security link
ae.description: India has demonstrated a 5.56-kilometre quantum key distribution link through open air, establishing a new domestic benchmark for secure optical communications and advancing preparations for satellite-based quantum networks. The successful field trial, conducted by QNu Labs, the Bhaskaracharya National Institute for Space Applications and Geo-informatics (BISAG-N) and IIT Gandhinagar, established a quantum communication channel between two facilities in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology announced the achievement on October 3, confirming that the experiment took place overnight on September 27–28. The system generated secure cryptographic keys at 230–260 bits per second while maintaining a quantum bit error rate below five per cent. The participating institutions also demonstrated successful encryption and decryption of test messages using the generated keys, establishing that the experimental quantum channel could operate alongside conventional communications infrastructure. The achievement represents India's first publicly announced free-space quantum key distribution demonstration at this distance. Unlike fibre-based systems, the technology transmits quantum signals through the atmosphere, allowing secure key exchange without a continuous physical cable between communicating locations. QNu Labs deployed its Armos quantum key distribution equipment alongside a pointing, acquisition and tracking system designed to maintain optical alignment between transmitting and receiving terminals. The experiment used a 1,550-nanometre optical channel and a differential phase shift decoy protocol. Precise alignment was essential because atmospheric disturbances and small movements can disrupt the transmission of weak quantum signals across extended distances. The reported error rate provided an important indication of transmission quality, while the secure key generation rate demonstrated the system's ability to produce cryptographic material for practical encryption applications. The generated keys were integrated into BISAG-N's Vedic Kavach platform, which incorporates post-quantum cryptography and quantum random number generation. This arrangement combined hardware-based quantum key distribution with software-based cryptographic protection. Researchers demonstrated the transmission of 256-bit encryption keys through an interface conforming to the ETSI GS QKD 014 specification, enabling a test message to be encrypted, transmitted and decrypted successfully. The hybrid architecture is intended to maintain cryptographic protection when the quantum channel becomes temporarily unavailable. Post-quantum cryptography uses mathematical algorithms designed to resist attacks from sufficiently powerful quantum computers, while quantum key distribution relies on the properties of quantum states to reveal potential interception. The two approaches address different security requirements and can operate together, although neither eliminates every vulnerability associated with communication networks, including compromised devices or implementation weaknesses. Sunil Gupta, co-founder and chief executive of QNu Labs, said quantum security would become meaningful at scale only when technologies moved beyond controlled laboratories and operated across actual communications infrastructure. He said the field trial demonstrated that quantum key distribution, supported by precise optical tracking, could function across a multi-kilometre atmospheric link while integrating with a post-quantum security layer. Vinay Thakur, director-general of BISAG-N, highlighted the integration of Vedic Kavach with quantum key distribution as evidence that complementary security technologies could address evolving protection requirements. The demonstration also has implications for India's proposed satellite quantum communication capabilities. Satellite-to-ground systems require quantum signals to pass through atmospheric conditions, making terrestrial free-space experiments useful for evaluating optical transmission and tracking technologies. However, the Gandhinagar experiment did not establish a satellite connection or demonstrate operational performance across orbital distances. Such applications require additional testing involving moving platforms, longer optical paths and changing atmospheric conditions. The achievement contributes to technical work associated with India's National Quantum Mission, which includes developing secure quantum communications and supporting technologies for terrestrial and space applications. Manish Tripathi, who oversees the Interdisciplinary School of Technology and Future at IIT Gandhinagar, described the experiment as a valuable field environment bringing together academic research, domestic technology development and practical testing. The participating organisations have not announced a timetable for commercial deployment or a subsequent satellite demonstration based on the trial. The reported performance figures describe the conditions achieved during the September experiment rather than guaranteed operating rates under different weather conditions or across other locations. BISAG-N contributed its Vedic Kavach encryption environment, IIT Gandhinagar provided the academic testing setting, and QNu Labs supplied the quantum distribution equipment and optical tracking technology used in the demonstration. sa.title: فلكية جدة: 5 شهب متوقعة في الساعة.. و8 أكتوبر أفضل ليالي رصد «التنينيات»
sa.description: أوضح رئيس الجمعية الفلكية بجدة المهندس ماجد أبوزاهرة، أن سماء السعودية والعالم العربي تشهد مساء اليوم الخميس 8 أكتوبر 2026، ذروة نشاط زخات شهب التنينيات، التي تنشط سنوياً خلال شهر أكتوبر، على أن تمتد فترة النشاط حتى 10 أكتوبر. وبيّن أن ذروة الزخة يُتوقع أن تحدث فجر الجمعة 9 أكتوبر عند الساعة 04:00 بتوقيت مكة المكرمة، بمعدل نظري يصل إلى نحو 5 شهب في الساعة في الظروف المثالية، مشيراً إلى أن هذا المعدل يعد منخفضاً مقارنة بزخات شهب رئيسية مثل البرشاويات والتوأميات. مسارات الشهب وأشار إلى أن ما يميز التنينيات هو أن أفضل فترة لرصدها تكون خلال الساعات الأولى من الليل، بخلاف العديد من زخات الشهب التي تكون فرص مشاهدتها أفضل قبيل الفجر، موضحاً أن مساء الخميس 8 أكتوبر يمثل نافذة الرصد الرئيسية لهذا العام، وذلك بعد حلول الظلام مباشرة. وأضاف أن نقطة إشعاع التنينيات، التي تتبعها ظاهرياً مسارات الشهب، تقع في الجزء الشمالي من كوكبة التنين بالقرب من النجم رأس الثعبان، وتظهر مرتفعة في السماء الشمالية الغربية بالنسبة للمناطق الواقعة في النصف الشمالي من الكرة الأرضية، ومنها معظم مناطق العالم العربي. وأكد أن رصد الشهب لا يتطلب استخدام التلسكوب أو المنظار، إذ يمكن مشاهدتها بالعين المجردة، لافتاً إلى أن اختيار موقع مظلم بعيد عن أضواء المدن يمثل العامل الأهم للحصول على أفضل فرصة للرصد. وبيّن أن القمر سيكون في طور الهلال المتناقص خلال ذروة التنينيات، مع إضاءة منخفضة، ما يقلل من تأثير ضوئه في رؤية الشهب، ويساعد على توفر سماء أكثر ظلمة، خصوصاً في المواقع البعيدة عن مصادر الإضاءة الصناعية. نصائح مهمة للمتابعين ونصح الراغبين في متابعة الزخة بالتوجه إلى موقع مظلم بعد حلول الظلام مساء 8 أكتوبر، وتوجيه النظر بصورة عامة نحو السماء الشمالية والشمالية الغربية، مع تجنب حصر الرؤية في نقطة الإشعاع، إذ يمكن أن تظهر الشهب في مناطق مختلفة من السماء، كما تكون مسارات الشهب البعيدة عن نقطة الإشعاع أطول وأكثر وضوحاً. وأوضح أن شهب التنينيات تنتج عندما تعبر الأرض مسار الحطام الذي خلفه المذنب 21P/جياكوبيني - زينر، حيث تدخل جزيئات الغبار والحطام الغلاف الجوي للأرض بسرعة تقارب 20 كيلومتراً في الثانية، فتسخن وتنتج الومضات الضوئية التي تظهر على هيئة شهب. وأشار إلى أن هذه السرعة تعد منخفضة نسبياً مقارنة بالعديد من زخات الشهب الأخرى، ولذلك تبدو شهب التنينيات بطيئة الحركة نسبياً أثناء عبورها السماء. عواصف شهابية قوية ولفت أبو زاهرة إلى أن هذه الزخة تتميز أيضاً بتاريخ من النشاط المفاجئ، إذ سجلت عواصف شهابية قوية عامي 1933 و1946، إلى جانب زيادات ملحوظة في معدلات النشاط خلال سنوات أخرى، إلا أنه لا توجد توقعات بحدوث عاصفة شهابية استثنائية خلال عام 2026. وأكد أن معدل 5 شهب في الساعة يمثل معدلاً نظرياً في ظروف مثالية، وليس عدداً مضموناً يمكن مشاهدته من موقع محدد، إذ يتأثر العدد الفعلي بعوامل عدة، من بينها التلوث الضوئي، وصفاء السماء، وارتفاع نقطة الإشعاع، إضافة إلى ضعف بعض الشهب التي قد لا تكون مرئية بالعين المجردة. ودعا إلى منح العينين نحو 20 دقيقة للتكيف مع الظلام، وتجنب النظر المباشر إلى الهواتف والمصابيح أو أي مصادر إضاءة قوية أثناء الرصد، موضحاً أن مساء الخميس 8 أكتوبر يمثل أفضل فرصة لمتابعة التنينيات في المناطق العربية، مع استمرار نشاط الزخة حتى 10 أكتوبر.

sa.description: يعود سالم الدوسري، قائد فريق الهلال الأول لكرة القدم، للظهور من جديد بالقميص الأزرق من على مقاعد دكة البدلاء خلال مواجهة «الكلاسيكو» أمام الاتحاد، السبت المقبل، في المباراة التي تجرى على ملعب «المملكة أرينا» في الرياض، ضمن الجولة الثامنة من دوري روشن السعودي، بعد غياب استمر طويلًا، وفق مصدر خاص بـ«الرياضية». وأشار المصدر ذاته، إلى أن قرار مشاركة سالم من عدمها في المباراة المقبلة، سيعود إلى الإيطالي سيموني إنزاجي، مدرب الفريق، وفق احتياجه له خلال المباراة. وشارك قائد الأزرق العاصمي في التدريبات الجماعية، الخميس الماضي، بعد أن أنهى برنامجه التأهيلي، وفق حساب النادي الرسمي عبر منصة «إكس». وكانت آخر مباراة خاضها الدوسري، بقميص الهلال في 21 مايو 2026 أمام الفيحاء في المجمعة في الجولة الأخيرة من الدوري، قبل أن يلتحق اللاعب بمعسكر الأخضر الإعدادي لنهائيات كأس العالم 2026. وأجرى سالم في يوليو الماضي عملية جراحية في وتر الركبة، على يد الطبيب الفنلندي لاسي ليمباينن، خضع بعدها لفترة علاجية وتأهيلية، تمهيدًا لعودته إلى الركض من جديد. ولم يشارك صاحب هدف الفوز التاريخي مع المنتخب السعودي ضد الأرجنتين في نهائيات كأس العالم 2022، مع الأخضر في «خليجي27» بسبب الإصابة، إذ يتوقع أن تكون عودته في مرحلة الإعداد للمشاركة في نهائيات كأس آسيا للمنتخبات التي تستضيفها السعودية بدءًا من 7 يناير حتى 5 فبراير المقبلين.

cm.title: CAB-CORRIDOR : le Cameroun se positionne au cœur de la souveraineté numérique régionale
cm.description: © DR Le directeur général de l'ANTIC, Pr. Ebot Ebot Enaw, a reçu le 30 septembre 2026 à Yaoundé le DG de la SPIN Gabon et le Président du CAMIX pour la présentation du projet CAB-CORRIDOR, qui vise à créer un corridor numérique terrestre en Afrique centrale. Le Cameroun veut devenir le hub numérique de l'Afrique centrale. Le 30 septembre 2026, le Pr. Ebot Ebot Enaw a reçu M. Bertrand Mahoukou Bitchinda, DG de la Société de Patrimoine des Infrastructures Numériques du Gabon, et M. Olivier Leloustre, Président du Cameroon Internet Exchange Point. Ils sont venus présenter CAB-CORRIDOR, une initiative portée par les opérateurs backbone de la sous-région pour mutualiser les réseaux de fibre optique existants. L'objectif est stratégique : créer des routes terrestres alternatives aux câbles sous-marins internationaux, dont la rupture paralyse régulièrement le continent, et assurer la résilience du réseau. Dans ce schéma, le Cameroun occupe une place centrale. Ses infrastructures autour de Kribi et Douala, points d'atterrage des câbles, sont désignées comme points de livraison majeurs du futur corridor. CAMTEL pourrait rejoindre le Groupement d'Intérêt Économique qui portera le projet. Au-delà de la technique, l'enjeu est économique et souverain. Le GIE commercialisera les capacités mutualisées et partagera les revenus, tout en diversifiant les routes de transit de données. Le DG de l'ANTIC a salué une initiative qui renforce la confiance numérique et la protection des données. Cet article CAB-CORRIDOR : le Cameroun se positionne au cœur de la souveraineté numérique régionale est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com.
